# Descriptions
@@ 2
Allows caster to go without food or water and not suffer damage (i.e.,
provides nutrition and water for 1 day).
@@ 3
Caster can produce sufficient water in any available receptacle to supply a
normal, humansized being for one day.
@@ 4
Caster can produce sufficient food from the surrounding area to feed 1 hearty
appetite for 1 day.
@@ 5
Allows caster to set a fire of 1 foot radius; fire will then last as long as
there is fuel. A target in the 1 foot radius will take an 'A' Heat critical.
@@ 6
Caster can produce 1 loaf of bread that weighs 0.5 lb. and will nutritionally
support 1 being for 1 day; the loaf will lose potency in 1 month.
@@ 7
As Water Production I, except caster can produce 3 days of water.
@@ 8
As Food Production I, except caster can produce sufficient food to feed 3
beings for 1 day.
@@ 9
Allows caster to enhance the potency of any 1 growing herb by 100% (i.e., by
2x, see notes below); spell may be employed only once per herb.
@@ 10
As Water Production I, except caster can produce 5 days of water.
@@ 11
As Food Production I, except caster can produce sufficient food to feed 5
beings for 1 day.
@@ 12
As Nutrient Conjure I, except caster can produce 3 loaves of waybread.
@@ 13
Caster can double the potency of any 1 herb (growing or dead); spell may be
employed only once/herb. May not be combined with Herb Enhancement.
@@ 15
Caster can produce a plant up to 10' in height and/or width; plant must be
commonly found in the region.
@@ 16
As Water Production I, except caster can create 1 day of water per level
(e.g., a 17th level Cleric could create 17 days of water).
@@ 17
As Food Production I, except caster can produce sufficient food to feed a
number of beings equal to his level.
@@ 20
Caster can create an animal representative of the surrounding region and
weighing no more than 10 pounds; animal will be friendly to caster.
@@ 25
As Nutrient Conjure I, except caster can produce loaves of waybread equal to
his level.
@@ 30
As Lesser Plant Production, except that caster can create 1 plant with a
height and/or width of 1' per level (e.g., a 30th level could produce a 20'
high tree with a 30' maximum width); plant must be commonly found in the local
area.
@@ 50
As Lesser Animal Production, except that caster can produce an animal with a
maximum weight of 1 pound per level; the animal must be a native of the area.
